statistical_scope.cluster: four passages per corpus; starts/arms/views/metrics/contrasts share indices
statistical_scope.primary: Eight predeclared K/V estimands x later NLL/baseline KL x eight source/start strata; all128 reported, no any-one-CI success rule.
statistical_scope.multiplicity: Nominal conditional95% intervals, unadjusted and correlated; no fit/population uncertainty or independent-replication interpretation.
statistical_scope.numerical_scope: Signed canonical FP32 KL retained. Selected R saved-logit FP64 diagnostics are not a whole-panel precision/sensitivity bound.
statistical_scope.limits: Finite donor transplants, unequal natural K/V doses; no mediation fraction, intrinsic path importance, unique circuit, equivalence or method-priority claim.

scope.norm_semantics: L11 actual Q/K/V and deltas from baseline versus original natural projection are distinct. Recipient L10 is baseline, never a hypothetical full edit.
scope.evidence: Runtime protected-region/closure flags and fingerprints are not independent raw reconstruction. Selected5 L10/9 L11/12 endstate panels require separate N/P/R audits.
scope.small_KL: Signed FP32 metrics unchanged; selected saved-logit FP64 R diagnostics cannot bound unsaved rows or establish sensitivity at1e-6 from a1e-4 consistency PASS.
scope.primary: All128 finite co-primary comparisons reported; no any-one-CI study-success rule.
